description: Look up a US federal (Article III) judge by name in the Federal Judicial Center biographical directory — every Supreme Court justice, court of appeals and district court judge since 1789. Returns each appointment: court, title, appointing president and party, ABA rating, nomination, hearing, confirmation and commission dates, Senate vote, chief-judge and senior-status dates, and when and how service ended; plus birth, death, education and professional career. Answers "who appointed Judge X", "when was X confirmed", "is X still serving", "where did X go to law school".

limit.description: Max matches returned in full (default 5, max 25).

name.description: Judge name, full or partial, e.g. "Ketanji Brown Jackson", "Sotomayor", "Learned Hand".

name: fjc_judge_lookup
title: Fjc Judge Lookup
